6365.title: Codex approval metadata rejection
6365.rootCauseOneLine: Tool-approval metadata validation failures normalize to unsupported and render only Decline; the original native CDP metadata and failing field remain unverified.
6365.proposedFix: Capture a sanitized native request shape and validation issue paths in an isolated session before considering a narrowly scoped compatibility change that retains fail-closed permission handling.
6365.caveats: Two clean boundary runs use deliberately malformed repository fixtures, not a real Browser Use CDP request. The screenshot is actual plugin DOM fixture output, not a live BB session. No PR: valid native rejection is unverified and consent changes fall outside the simple-fix policy.
